description:
[Food contact materials (FCM) overall & specific migration limit screener. Deterministic calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Evaluates food contact material compliance under Regulation (EC) No 1935/2004 and Regulation (EU) No 10/2011, checking overall migration limit (10 mg/dm²), specific migration limits (SML), and simulant coverage.
Usage: Pass material type, food category, migration test measurements, and Declaration of Compliance status to audit food safety.
Returns: JSON object with { materialTradeName: string, overallMigrationLimitCheck: object, specificMigrationAudit: object, simulantsSuitabilityCheck: object, statutoryVerdict: string, nonComplianceReasons: array, docRequirementsMet: boolean }.

contactDurationHours.description: Maximum foreseeable contact duration in hours

containsRecycledPlasticReg2022_1616.description: If plastic contains recycled content, whether process is certified under Regulation (EU) 2022/1616

declarationOfComplianceIssued.description: Whether written Declaration of Compliance (DoC) ex Article 16 is issued

intendedFoodCategory.description: Nature of foodstuffs intended to come into contact with the material

materialTradeName.description: Commercial name or trade reference of the food packaging material

materialType.description: Chemical and structural classification of the contact material

maximumContactTemperatureCelsius.description: Highest intended contact temperature in degrees Celsius (e.g. 100°C for boiling/hot fill)

overallMigrationMgPerDm2.description: Measured Overall Migration in mg/dm² (statutory limit: 10.0 mg/dm²)

specificSubstancesMigration.description: Substances subject to Specific Migration Limits (SML)

measuredMigrationMgPerKg.description: Measured specific migration in mg/kg food or simulant

statutorySmlMgPerKg.description: Statutory Specific Migration Limit (SML) in mg/kg under Annex I

substanceName.description: Chemical substance or additive name (e.g. Bisphenol A, Phthalates, PAA)

testedWithFoodSimulants.description: Food simulants used in laboratory migration tests ex Annex III

name: food_contact_materials_fcm_screener
